SELECT SEQ_DRIVE_ITEM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_DRIVE( DRIVE_ITEM_ID, PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, EMP_ID, ITEM_TYPE_CD, BOOKMARK_YN, ITEM_NM, FRST_REG_DT, DEL_YN, DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID )VALUES( #{driveItemId}, #{prntDriveItemId}, #{empId}, #{itemTypeCd}, 'N', #{itemNm}, SYSDATE, 'N', #{driveAtchFileId} )
mapper.select: SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.EMP_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.BOOKMARK_YN, D.ITEM_NM, D.FRST_REG_DT, D.LAST_MDFCN_DT, DTL.FILE_SZ, DTL.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM TB_DRIVE D LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL DTL ON D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID = DTL.ATCH_FILE_DTL_ID WHERE D.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (#{prntDriveItemId} IS NULL AND D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID IS NULL) OR D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{prntDriveItemId} ) ORDER BY D.ITEM_TYPE_CD ASC, D.FRST_REG_DT ASC

SELECT DRIVE_ITEM_ID, PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, EMP_ID, ITEM_TYPE_CD, BOOKMARK_YN, ITEM_NM, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFCN_DT, DEL_YN, DEL_DT, DELTR_MBR_ID, DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID FROM TB_DRIVE WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DRIVE SET ITEM_NM = #{itemNm}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TB_DRIVE SET BOOKMARK_YN = 'Y', LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TB_DRIVE SET BOOKMARK_YN = 'N', LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE TB_DRIVE SET DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_DT = SYSDATE, DELTR_MBR_ID = #{deltrMbrId} WHERE DRIVE_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT DRIVE_ITEM_ID FROM TB_DRIVE START WITH DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR DRIVE_ITEM_ID = PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID ) AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, D.ITEM_TYPE_CD, D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID FROM TB_DRIVE D WHERE D.DEL_YN = 'N' START WITH D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = #{driveItemId} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DRIVE_ITEM_ID = D.PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID
